description: Add a full CFA mock exam simulation mode: 180 questions, 270 minutes, realistic subject weightings, results analysis with passing threshold comparison, and history tracking
steps: Create src/features/mock-exam/ directory: types/, utils/, components/
Create src/features/mock-exam/types/index.ts with types: MockExamConfig, MockExamResult, MockExamHistory, SubjectWeighting, ExamProgress

Create src/features/mock-exam/utils/exam-config.ts with CFA Level I subject weightings per CFA Institute curriculum: Ethics (15-20%), Quant (6-9%), Economics (6-9%), FRA (11-14%), Corporate (6-9%), Equity (11-14%), Fixed Income (11-14%), Derivatives (5-8%), Alt Investments (5-8%), Portfolio Management (5-8%). Define PASSING_THRESHOLD = 0.65-0.70 range

Create src/features/mock-exam/utils/question-selector.ts that selects 180 questions from the existing question bank (src/features/question-bank/data/) following the subject weightings. If insufficient questions in a subject, fill proportionally from available pool
Create src/features/mock-exam/utils/storage.ts for localStorage persistence of mock exam history (key: 'cfa-buddy-mock-exams')
Create src/features/mock-exam/utils/scoring.ts for calculating results: overall score, per-subject breakdown, comparison to passing threshold, pass/fail determination

Create src/features/mock-exam/components/mock-exam-landing.tsx - landing page showing: exam rules (180 questions, 270 min, no breaks), subject weighting breakdown table, start button, previous exam history summary

Create src/features/mock-exam/components/mock-exam-session.tsx - the exam session component: question display with answer choices, question navigation (numbered grid), timer countdown (270 min), flag for review button, progress indicator

Create src/features/mock-exam/components/mock-exam-results.tsx - results page showing: overall score %, pass/fail verdict, per-subject scores with bar chart, comparison to passing threshold line, time analysis, score progression chart from history
Create src/features/mock-exam/components/mock-exam-history.tsx - shows past exam attempts: date, score, pass/fail, trend line
Add route: src/app/(protected)/mock-exam/page.tsx that renders MockExamLanding
Add 'Mock Exam' link to sidebar navigation in src/shared/components/layout/sidebar.tsx
Add unit tests in src/features/mock-exam/__tests__/question-selector.test.ts and scoring.test.ts
Run full verification: npm run lint, npx tsc --noEmit, npm run build, npm run test
acceptance_criteria: /mock-exam page shows exam rules and start button
Exam session presents 180 questions with 270-minute timer
Questions are weighted by CFA Level I subject distribution
Results page shows score vs passing threshold (65-70%)
Per-subject breakdown displayed with visual chart
Exam history tracks score progression over time
Mock Exam link appears in sidebar navigation
All tests pass, lint clean, build succeeds
verification: eval "$(mise activate bash)" && npm run lint
eval "$(mise activate bash)" && npm run build
eval "$(mise activate bash)" && npm run test
findings: All 336 tests pass (21 new mock-exam tests). Build and lint clean. The question bank has ~1334 questions total across 6 subject areas (not all 10 CFA subjects have dedicated question files). The question selector gracefully handles missing subjects by distributing proportionally from available pool. Used useMemo instead of useState+useEffect for derived data to satisfy React purity lint rules. Recharts Tooltip formatter/labelFormatter callbacks must not have explicit type annotations to pass strict recharts typing.
